svg.title: A year of building — brianvarskonst
svg.desc: brianvarskonst's visible GitHub contribution calendar, 2025-09-28 to 2026-10-02: 2,250 contributions across 143 active days. The public calendar can include anonymized private contributions when the profile owner enables them. Each plot represents one date; building height follows its contribution count, and empty plots represent zero contributions. Colors follow GitHub's daily activity levels. This records contribution activity, not productivity or quality.
